title: Which diseases manifest as epigastric pain?
query:
# Which diseases manifest as epigastric pain?
PREFIX gk:      <http://example.org/gastrokg/ontology#>
PREFIX gkd:     <http://example.org/gastrokg/data#>
PREFIX rdfs:    <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX skos:    <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
SELECT ?code ?disease WHERE {
  ?d gk:manifestsAs gkd:EpigastricPain ; gk:code ?code ; rdfs:label ?disease . FILTER(LANG(?disease) = "en" || LANG(?disease) = "")
} ORDER BY ?code

title: Which symptoms are emergency symptoms? (sub-class inference, rdfs9 / rdfs11)
query:
# Which symptoms are emergency symptoms? (sub-class inference, rdfs9 / rdfs11)
PREFIX gk:      <http://example.org/gastrokg/ontology#>
PREFIX gkd:     <http://example.org/gastrokg/data#>
PREFIX rdfs:    <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX skos:    <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?code ?symptom WHERE {
  ?s a gk:EmergencySymptom ; gk:code ?code ; rdfs:label ?symptom . FILTER(LANG(?symptom) = "en" || LANG(?symptom) = "")
} ORDER BY ?code
rows: Sudden, severe or constant abdominal pain
Pain in the chest, jaw, neck or arm

title: Which diseases affect the upper GI tract? (property chain + transitivity)
query:
# Which diseases affect the upper GI tract? (property chain + transitivity)
PREFIX gk:      <http://example.org/gastrokg/ontology#>
PREFIX gkd:     <http://example.org/gastrokg/data#>

PREFIX skos:    <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?code ?disease WHERE {
  ?d gk:affects gkd:UpperGITract ; gk:code ?code ; rdfs:label ?disease . FILTER(LANG(?disease) = "en" || LANG(?disease) = "")
} ORDER BY ?code

title: What is the ranked differential diagnosis of encounter E001?
query:
# What is the ranked differential diagnosis of encounter E001?
PREFIX gk:      <http://example.org/gastrokg/ontology#>
PREFIX gkd:     <http://example.org/gastrokg/data#>
PREFIX rdfs:    <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX skos:    <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
SELECT ?rank ?code ?cf ?status ?coverage WHERE {
  ?h a gk:Hypothesis ; gk:ofEncounter gkd:E001 ; gk:rank ?rank ; gk:certaintyFactor ?cf ;
     gk:forDisease ?d ; gk:matchStatus ?s ; gk:ruleCoverage ?coverage .
  ?d gk:code ?code .
  BIND(STRAFTER(STR(?s), "#") AS ?status)
} ORDER BY ?rank

title: How was the certainty factor of GERD in E001 built, step by step?
query:
# How was the certainty factor of GERD in E001 built, step by step?
PREFIX gk:      <http://example.org/gastrokg/ontology#>
PREFIX gkd:     <http://example.org/gastrokg/data#>
PREFIX rdfs:    <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX skos:    <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
SELECT ?step ?symptom ?itemCF ?before ?after WHERE {
  ?item a gk:EvidenceItem ; gk:ofHypothesis gkd:E001_P03 ; gk:sequence ?step ; gk:itemCF ?itemCF ;
        gk:cumulativeBefore ?before ; gk:cumulativeAfter ?after ; gk:basedOnLink ?link .
  ?link gk:aboutSymptom ?s . ?s gk:code ?symptom .
} ORDER BY ?step

title: What is still missing to complete a rule in encounter E003?
query:
# What is still missing to complete a rule in encounter E003?
PREFIX gk:      <http://example.org/gastrokg/ontology#>
PREFIX gkd:     <http://example.org/gastrokg/data#>
PREFIX rdfs:    <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX skos:    <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
SELECT ?disease ?coverage ?missing WHERE {
  ?h a gk:Hypothesis ; gk:ofEncounter gkd:E003 ; gk:forDisease ?d ; gk:ruleCoverage ?coverage ;
     gk:missingSymptom ?s .
  ?d gk:code ?disease . ?s gk:code ?missing .
} ORDER BY ?disease ?missing

title: Which encounters are emergencies, and because of which symptom?
query:
# Which encounters are emergencies, and because of which symptom?
PREFIX gk:      <http://example.org/gastrokg/ontology#>
PREFIX gkd:     <http://example.org/gastrokg/data#>
PREFIX rdfs:    <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX skos:    <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
SELECT ?encounter ?symptom WHERE {
  ?e a gk:Encounter ; gk:finalTriage gkd:Emergency .
  ?t a gk:TriageDecision ; gk:ofEncounter ?e ; gk:triageLevel gkd:Emergency ; gk:triggeredBy ?s .
  ?s gk:code ?symptom .
  BIND(STRAFTER(STR(?e), "#") AS ?encounter)
} ORDER BY ?encounter ?symptom

title: What is the final triage level and care facility of every encounter?
query:
# What is the final triage level and care facility of every encounter?
PREFIX gk:      <http://example.org/gastrokg/ontology#>
PREFIX gkd:     <http://example.org/gastrokg/data#>
PREFIX rdfs:    <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX skos:    <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
SELECT ?encounter ?level ?facility WHERE {
  ?e a gk:Encounter ; gk:finalTriage ?l .
  ?l gk:refersTo ?f .
  BIND(STRAFTER(STR(?e), "#") AS ?encounter)
  BIND(STRAFTER(STR(?l), "#") AS ?level)
  BIND(STRAFTER(STR(?f), "#") AS ?facility)
} ORDER BY ?encounter

query:

title: Which medication safety alerts exist, how severe, and what could be discussed instead?
query:
# Which medication safety alerts exist, how severe, and what could be discussed instead?
PREFIX gk:      <http://example.org/gastrokg/ontology#>
PREFIX gkd:     <http://example.org/gastrokg/data#>
PREFIX rdfs:    <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX skos:    <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
SELECT ?encounter ?medicine ?severity ?alternative ?reason WHERE {
  ?a a gk:SafetyAlert ; gk:ofEncounter ?e ; gk:concernsMedication ?m ; gk:severity ?severity ; gk:reason ?reason .
  OPTIONAL { ?a gk:suggestedAlternative ?alt }
  BIND(STRAFTER(STR(?e), "#") AS ?encounter)
  BIND(STRAFTER(STR(?m), "#") AS ?medicine)
  BIND(STRAFTER(STR(?alt), "#") AS ?alternative)
} ORDER BY ?encounter ?medicine ?reason
rows: Long-term NSAID use can injure the stomach lining.
NSAIDs are a common cause of peptic ulcers.
NSAIDs can cause or worsen reflux disease.
Taking an NSAID with an anticoagulant raises the risk of bleeding.
Taking an NSAID with an anticoagulant raises the risk of bleeding.
Opioid pain medicines can delay stomach emptying or worsen symptoms.

title: What should the system ask next? (backward chaining)
query:
# What should the system ask next? (backward chaining)
PREFIX gk:      <http://example.org/gastrokg/ontology#>
PREFIX gkd:     <http://example.org/gastrokg/data#>
PREFIX rdfs:    <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX skos:    <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
SELECT ?encounter ?symptom ?score WHERE {
  ?q a gk:QuestionSuggestion ; gk:rank 1 ; gk:ofEncounter ?e ; gk:askSymptom ?s ; gk:discriminationScore ?score .
  ?s gk:code ?symptom .
  BIND(STRAFTER(STR(?e), "#") AS ?encounter)
} ORDER BY ?encounter

title: Where do the certainty weights come from?
query:
# Where do the certainty weights come from?
PREFIX gk:      <http://example.org/gastrokg/ontology#>
PREFIX gkd:     <http://example.org/gastrokg/data#>
PREFIX rdfs:    <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX skos:    <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
SELECT ?status ?sourceType (COUNT(DISTINCT ?link) AS ?links) WHERE {
  ?link a gk:EvidenceLink ; gk:weightStatus ?w ; dcterms:source ?src .
  BIND(STRAFTER(STR(?w), "#") AS ?status)
  BIND(IF(?src = gkd:GroupAssignment, "group assignment or modelling choice", "public health source") AS ?sourceType)
} GROUP BY ?status ?sourceType ORDER BY ?status ?sourceType

title: Which evidence argues against a hypothesis in E011?
query:
# Which evidence argues against a hypothesis in E011?
PREFIX gk:      <http://example.org/gastrokg/ontology#>
PREFIX gkd:     <http://example.org/gastrokg/data#>
PREFIX rdfs:    <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX skos:    <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
SELECT ?disease ?symptom ?itemCF WHERE {
  ?item a gk:EvidenceItem ; gk:ofEncounter gkd:E011 ; gk:polarity gkd:Oppose ; gk:itemCF ?itemCF ;
        gk:basedOnLink ?link .
  ?link gk:ofDisease ?d ; gk:aboutSymptom ?s .
  ?d gk:code ?disease . ?s gk:code ?symptom .
} ORDER BY ?disease ?symptom
